crossRefs.note: He alone is my rock, my salvation, and my fortress. I will never be greatly shaken.
For who is God, except Yahweh? Who is a rock, besides our God,
the God who arms me with strength, and makes my way perfect?
Israel will be saved by Yahweh with an everlasting salvation. You will not be disappointed nor confounded to ages…
But I will have mercy on the house of Judah, and will save them by Yahweh their God, and will not save them by bow…
I have set Yahweh always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
For he will never be shaken. The righteous will be remembered forever.
The righteous will never be removed, but the wicked will not dwell in the land.
The wicked are overthrown, and are no more, but the house of the righteous shall stand.

translations.web: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will not be shaken.
translations.bsb: He alone is my rock and my salvation; He is my fortress; I will not be shaken.
translations.kjv: He only is my rock and my salvation: he is my defence; I shall not be moved.
translations.asv: He only is my rock and my salvation: He is my high tower; I shall not be moved.
